title: X.G100 Grey

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Engineered for adaptable touring, the Nexx X.G100 Grey is engineered for seamless transitions between open-face city stops and full-face highway cruising across highway and urban riding. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell tips the scales at 1590g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~87 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Modular design allows for interchangeable visors and chin guards; fits most head shapes but may require sizing adjustment for extended necks.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Nexx X.G100 Grey: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Nexx X.G100 Grey: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Nexx X.G100 Grey. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in

ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

introduction: Positioned in Nexx's Modular lineup, the X.G100 Grey brings Portuguese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Nexx X.G100 Grey represents Nexx's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~87 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Nexx X.G100 Grey delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
